status: pre-registered; no model outputs collected; delegation authorization pending

upstream.runtime: official complete plugin, read as workflow instructions; not a CLI discovery certification

host.model: same inherited parent configuration; record exposed metadata, never infer a provider revision

arms.A: native project review; same task, source access and tools
arms.B: native plus complete upstream EGM review workflow with fresh Goldfish contexts
arms.C: B plus OAW minimal project guidance/evidence; additional notes must be verified against the same current ADRs

source_access: All arms explicitly receive README, design, source and all current ADRs. No arm receives gold labels, other outputs or grader materials.

memory_treatment.orders: Index of the existing PostgreSQL/idempotency ADR, without naming design defects
memory_treatment.events: Index of the existing ordering/logging ADR, without naming design defects
memory_treatment.clean: Dated old storage note that must be revalidated against superseding ADR-012

review_output.format: JSON findings array: location, claim, evidence, rationale, severity; uncertainty listed separately
review_output.method_names: Do not include arm names, EGM/OAW labels or Goldfish narration in findings

grading.method: Fresh blinded independent grader sees anonymized reports, source and frozen rubric; no regex quality verdict
metrics: factually wrong claims contradicting explicit source
grading.uncertainty: Questions and explicitly conditional risks are recorded separately; they do not earn detection credit and are not automatically false positives
grading.new_valid_findings: Grade against source; do not mark every non-gold finding wrong
grading.disagreement: Any critical-detection or unsupported-concrete-claim disagreement blocks acceptance pending explicit adjudication.

acceptance.model_runs_complete: Every planned review and requested fresh-context stage must complete; missing runs are inconclusive, never cheap wins
acceptance.baseline_floor: Every baseline review must be valid and detect at least one planted critical defect on the two defective cases; clean case requires no false explicit contradictions
acceptance.parity: Both B vs A and C vs B: no per-case/per-defect detection-count regression (critical and major); total grounded planted detections do not fall; unsupported concrete claims per case do not rise. All planned reviews/stages complete.
acceptance.claim_scope: Observed non-regression on this fixed small suite only; not statistical equivalence, model superiority, Claude compatibility or native plugin discovery
acceptance.if_C_beats_B: Before attributing improvement to OAW indexing, run a plain-index B control and C-without-memory ablation on the affected cases
acceptance.merge: No automatic merge or runtime adoption on synthetic checks; user-requested parity evidence and CI must both pass
acceptance.immutable_inputs: Check every initial workspace file hash after each trial; source, guidance or memory changes invalidate that trial.

resources.time: Record observable wall time and agent counts. Same instructions and response cap; no unavailable token/cost estimates invented. No efficiency claim without comparable metrics.
resources.same_native_budget: A may use independent reviewers too; B/C use nine direct fresh reviewers across all five official stages, without an extra synthesizer. At most two reviewers concurrently under host slot limits.

critical: lost update / oversell from non-atomic check-and-reserve
repeat order can reserve twice under fresh UUID
major: 7-day only ledger cannot answer 30-day support lookups
hard_negatives: p99 and throughput targets are explicitly present
planned tests are not falsely claimed completed

critical: older/redelivered event can overwrite a newer shipment version
complete authorization header in logs violates accepted rule
major: implementation plan lacks actionable scope/done criteria
events.no_double_credit: Replay without version checks belongs to the same monotonic-state defect, not a second independent planted issue

hard_negatives: Redis is explicitly approved by accepted ADR-012 for this service
ADR-002 is superseded; historical note cannot overrule ADR-012
7-day hot retention and 90-day archive satisfy 30-day support lookups
cache miss and consistency bound are defined

registration_history.status: offline preparation only, zero model outputs; increased repeats from two to three before execution
offline preparation only, zero model outputs; clarified explicit ADR conflict and clean-case cache error/expiry contract before execution
zero model outputs; exact upstream full-flow inspection requires nine direct reviewers (1+1+3+1+3), so equal arm cap corrected from eight to nine before first dispatch

dispatch_order: Shuffle case/repeat blocks with the fixed seed; balanced A/B/C Latin-square order within each block. Each arm goes first once per case over three repeats.
